 X Home >   Southern States >   Telangana >   Telangana 10th SSC 2027... Telangana 10th SSC 2027 Exam Fee Date Deadline Extended 
 Telangana SSC 2027 exam fee last date revised to November 26 without late fee; check late fee dates and other details.
 By :   DC Web Desk Update: 2026-11-16 10:16 GMT Representational Image 
 Hyderabad: The Telangana School Education Department has revised the SSC 10th Public Examinations 2027 fee payment date, with extended deadlines available for payments carrying late fees. Students can pay the exam fee without late charges until November 26 for the  SSC examinations to be held in March 2027.  
 School headmasters have been directed to complete the online fee payment process by November 27. For the convenience of students, the department has allowed paying the fee with a late fee in different stages: 
 Till November 26: Without any late fee 
 Till December 8: With Rs 50 late fee 
 December 10 to 21: With Rs 200 penalty fee 
 December 23 to January 4: With Rs 500 late fee 
 The exam fee for all subjects in Class 10 has been fixed at Rs 125. Similarly, the fee for up to three subjects is Rs.110.  Vocational course students will have to pay an additional Rs 60. 
 However, eligible students belonging to SC, ST and BC categories will be exempted from the exam fee . 
 Fee to be paid online only 
 Headmasters must pay the students' exam fee only through the school login on the official website bse.telangana.gov.in. Officials have clarified that payments through IFMS challans and bank challans will not be accepted. 
 Students and parents have been advised to complete the fee payment process on time without waiting till the last date.
